key: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Shieldon.
en: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Shieldon.
ja: タテトプスに近縁と考えられる、小型ポケモンの化石。

key: Please enjoy!
en: Please enjoy!
ja: どうぞお楽しみください!

key: Remember, don't touch the exhibits.
en: Remember, don't touch the exhibits.
ja: 展示品には触れないよう、お願いします。

key: Generations of locations, all for your perusal!
en: Generations of locations, all for your perusal!
ja: 何世代にもわたる場所の数々を、ごゆっくりご覧ください!

key: ATTENDANT: Hello! Welcome to the historic Spinel Town Museum!
en: ATTENDANT: Hello! Welcome to the historic Spinel Town Museum!
ja: 係員: こんにちは! 歴史あるスピネルタウン博物館へようこそ!

key: \GAdmittance is a $500 fee. Is that all right?
en: \GAdmittance is a $500 fee. Is that all right?
ja: \G入館料は$500です。よろしいですか?

key: Thank you very much! Please enjoy everything the Spinel Town Museum has to offer!
en: Thank you very much! Please enjoy everything the Spinel Town Museum has to offer!
ja: ありがとうございます! スピネルタウン博物館の展示を、存分にお楽しみください!

key: I'm afraid you don't have that much on-hand. Please come back again some time though!
en: I'm afraid you don't have that much on-hand. Please come back again some time though!
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、お手持ちが足りないようです。またのお越しをお待ちしております!

key: Please visit us some time!
en: Please visit us some time!
ja: ぜひまた、お越しください!

key: A portrait of the city's rising star.
en: A portrait of the city's rising star.
ja: 街の新星を描いた肖像画。

key: A portrait of the region's fallen star.
en: A portrait of the region's fallen star.
ja: 地方の落ちた星を描いた肖像画。

key: "Artifacts found in a ruin deep beneath Reborn City.
en: "Artifacts found in a ruin deep beneath Reborn City.
ja: 「リボーンシティの地下深くの遺跡で見つかった遺物。

key: It's said that they could be a form of old-fashioned Poké Ball!"
en: It's said that they could be a form of old-fashioned Poké Ball!"
ja: 昔ながらのモンスターボールの一種ではないかと言われている!」

key: It's said their craftsmanship bears strong resemblance to the old legend of Pokéopolis."
en: It's said their craftsmanship bears strong resemblance to the old legend of Pokéopolis."
ja: 「その細工は、古の伝説「ポケオポリス」と強い類似性を持つと言われている」

key: "A gold nugget taken from the ruin beneath Reborn City.
en: "A gold nugget taken from the ruin beneath Reborn City.
ja: 「リボーンシティの地下の遺跡から採取された金塊。

key: Because of the high karat material and its size, this object could be worth up to ten times more than a normal nugget!"
en: Because of the high karat material and its size, this object could be worth up to ten times more than a normal nugget!"
ja: 高純度の素材とその大きさから、通常の金塊の十倍もの価値があるかもしれない!」

key: Most everything here has been recovered from the old ruin beneath Reborn.
en: Most everything here has been recovered from the old ruin beneath Reborn.
ja: ここにあるもののほとんどは、リボーンの地下にある古い遺跡から発掘されたものです。

key: Would you like to hear about it?
en: Would you like to hear about it?
ja: お聞きになりますか?

key: Although the city was destroyed within the past decade, this wasn't the first era of destruction the region has known.
en: Although the city was destroyed within the past decade, this wasn't the first era of destruction the region has known.
ja: この街はここ十年で破壊されましたが、この地方が破壊を経験したのは、これが初めてではありません。

key: Long ago-- much, much longer--
en: Long ago-- much, much longer--
ja: ずっと昔――もっともっと昔――

key: An ancient civilization called this ground their home.
en: An ancient civilization called this ground their home.
ja: 古代の文明が、この地を故郷としていました。

key: Little is known about them, but some of their structures still remain--
en: Little is known about them, but some of their structures still remain--
ja: 彼らについてはほとんど知られていませんが、いくつかの構造物は今も残っています――

key: Ancient inscriptions, tomes and such artifacts.
en: Ancient inscriptions, tomes and such artifacts.
ja: 古代の碑文、書物、そういった遺物です。

key: These are the things we've gathered here.
en: These are the things we've gathered here.
ja: それらを、ここに集めているのです。

key: Collectively, they speak of a certain object, heralded by the culture as the centrepiece of their religion.
en: Collectively, they speak of a certain object, heralded by the culture as the centrepiece of their religion.
ja: それらをまとめると、その文化において宗教の中心とされた、ある物体について語っています。

key: For all we know, whatever it is could still be buried beneath the rebuilt city!
en: For all we know, whatever it is could still be buried beneath the rebuilt city!
ja: それが何であれ、再建された街の下に、まだ埋まっているかもしれません!

key: We'd never know!
en: We'd never know!
ja: 誰にもわからないでしょうね!

key: Fascinating, isn't it?
en: Fascinating, isn't it?
ja: 興味深いと思いませんか?

key: The inscription on display describes the ancient city beneath what was later constructed into Reborn City.
en: The inscription on display describes the ancient city beneath what was later constructed into Reborn City.
ja: 展示された碑文には、後にリボーンシティが築かれた場所の下にある古代都市について記されている。

key: "Winding tunnels forged of stone glowing with power..."
en: "Winding tunnels forged of stone glowing with power..."
ja: 「力に輝く石で鍛えられた、曲がりくねったトンネル……」

key: "...A massive cathedral constructed around the crater..."
en: "...A massive cathedral constructed around the crater..."
ja: 「……クレーターの周りに築かれた、巨大な大聖堂……」

key: The inscription on display describes the artifact at the center of an ancient city.
en: The inscription on display describes the artifact at the center of an ancient city.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古代都市の中心にあった遺物について記されている。

key: "An enormous enigmatic stone burning with energy..."
en: "An enormous enigmatic stone burning with energy..."
ja: 「エネルギーで燃える、巨大で謎めいた石……」

key: "...Descended from the heavens..."
en: "...Descended from the heavens..."
ja: 「……天より降臨せし……」

key: The inscription on display describes the deity of an ancient civilization.
en: The inscription on display describes the deity of an ancient civilization.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古代文明の神について記されている。

key: "Born of the heaven-sent stone..."
en: "Born of the heaven-sent stone..."
ja: 「天より遣わされし石より生まれ……」

key: "...Ivory coat and with an arching collar..."
en: "...Ivory coat and with an arching collar..."
ja: 「……象牙の毛並みと、弧を描く襟……」

key: The inscription on display describes the temple raised to protect an old site.
en: The inscription on display describes the temple raised to protect an old site.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古の聖地を守るために建てられた神殿について記されている。

key: "Four keys of the stone's door..."
en: "Four keys of the stone's door..."
ja: 「石の扉を開く、四つの鍵……」

key: "...Carved from blessed crystal cast..."
en: "...Carved from blessed crystal cast..."
ja: 「……祝福された結晶より削り出されし……」

key: The inscription on display describes the night of an old meteor.
en: The inscription on display describes the night of an old meteor.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古のいん石が落ちた夜について記されている。

key: "Thought to be the end of the world..."
en: "Thought to be the end of the world..."
ja: 「世界の終わりと思われしが……」

key: "...But it was only the beginning..."
en: "...But it was only the beginning..."
ja: 「……それは、始まりに過ぎなかった……」

key: The inscription on display describes the creation of the world as believed by the ancient race.
en: The inscription on display describes the creation of the world as believed by the ancient race.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古代の種族が信じていた世界創造について記されている。

key: "The ivory beast begat its light..."
en: "The ivory beast begat its light..."
ja: 「象牙の獣、その光を生みしとき……」

key: "...And through a song in the darkness, was the first breath breathed into like creatures..."
en: "...And through a song in the darkness, was the first breath breathed into like creatures..."
ja: 「……そして闇の中の歌を通じて、同じ姿の生き物たちに、初めての息が吹き込まれた……」

key: The display exhibits various records of Pokémon being known to come from space.
en: The display exhibits various records of Pokémon being known to come from space.
ja: この展示は、宇宙から来たことが知られているポケモンについての、様々な記録を紹介している。

key: The DNA of a Clefairy and the digitized DNA of a Deoxys are laid side-by-side for comparison.
en: The DNA of a Clefairy and the digitized DNA of a Deoxys are laid side-by-side for comparison.
ja: ピッピのDNAと、デジタル化されたデオキシスのDNAが、比較のために並べて展示されている。

key: GRUNT: This is the one, right?
en: GRUNT: This is the one, right?
ja: メテオ団員: これで間違いないよな?

key: GRUNT: It's got to be.
en: GRUNT: It's got to be.
ja: メテオ団員: 間違いないはずだ。

key: It's the only one that talks about Ar--
en: It's the only one that talks about Ar--
ja: アル――について書かれてるのは、これだけだし――

key: GRUNT: You!
en: GRUNT: You!
ja: メテオ団員: お前!

key: GRUNT: What are you doing here?
en: GRUNT: What are you doing here?
ja: メテオ団員: ここで何してる?

key: Come to ruin our day again?!
en: Come to ruin our day again?!
ja: また、オレたちの邪魔をしに来たのか?!

key: I haven't forgotten about you cramming me into that cage back at Blacksteam!
en: I haven't forgotten about you cramming me into that cage back at Blacksteam!
ja: ブラックスチームで、オレをおりに押し込んだこと、忘れてないからな!

key: GRUNT: I think some payback is in order!
en: GRUNT: I think some payback is in order!
ja: メテオ団員: そろそろ、仕返しの時間じゃないか!

key: GRUNT: Or can we ruin yours?
en: GRUNT: Or can we ruin yours?
ja: メテオ団員: それとも、お前の邪魔をしてやろうか?

key: GRUNT: In a place like this?
en: GRUNT: In a place like this?
ja: メテオ団員: こんな場所でか?

key: The boss wouldn't be happy if we made that much commotion.
en: The boss wouldn't be happy if we made that much commotion.
ja: こんなに騒ぎを起こしたら、ボスが喜ばないぞ。

key: GRUNT: Tch, fine.
en: GRUNT: Tch, fine.
ja: メテオ団員: チッ、いいだろう。

key: \PN, that's your name, right?!
en: \PN, that's your name, right?!
ja: \PN、それがお前の名前だったよな?!

key: Come meet us in Tanzan Mountain, if you dare!
en: Come meet us in Tanzan Mountain, if you dare!
ja: 度胸があるなら、タンザン山で会おうぜ!

key: Curs like them... No telling what they're up to.
en: Curs like them... No telling what they're up to.
ja: あんな連中……何を企んでいるかわかったものではありません。

key: I wouldn't trust anyone dressed like that.
en: I wouldn't trust anyone dressed like that.
ja: あんな格好をした者は、信用しない方がいいでしょう。

key: You're always welcome here, friend.
en: You're always welcome here, friend.
ja: あなたはいつでも歓迎ですよ、お客様。

key: My word, did you really meet their challenge?
en: My word, did you really meet their challenge?
ja: おやおや、本当にあの者たちの挑戦を受けたのですか?

key: You're quite brave to fight those strange ones off.
en: You're quite brave to fight those strange ones off.
ja: あの怪しい者たちを追い払うとは、実に勇敢ですね。

key: And this museum is better for it.
en: And this museum is better for it.
ja: おかげで、この博物館も助かりました。

key: I'll tell you what, benevolent bystander.
en: I'll tell you what, benevolent bystander.
ja: それでは、慈悲深いお客様に。

key: Allow me to reward your courage with one of the Museum's private fossils.
en: Allow me to reward your courage with one of the Museum's private fossils.
ja: あなたの勇気に対して、博物館秘蔵の化石のひとつをお贈りしましょう。

key: Would you like the Plume Fossil or the Cover Fossil?
en: Would you like the Plume Fossil or the Cover Fossil?
ja: はねのカセキと、ふたのカセキ、どちらがよろしいですか?

key: It's all yours.
en: It's all yours.
ja: どうぞお受け取りください。

key: Smeargle takes out a noteboard and draws something on it.
en: Smeargle takes out a noteboard and draws something on it.
ja: ドーブルがノートボードを取り出し、何かを描いている。

key: "hi, my job is restore painting"
en: "hi, my job is restore painting"
ja: 「こんにちは、私の仕事は絵画の修復です」

key: One day, Frosty, you'll look like that too!
en: One day, Frosty, you'll look like that too!
ja: いつかフロスティも、あんな風になるのかな!

key: Isn't that amazing?!
en: Isn't that amazing?!
ja: すごいと思わない?!

key: Amaura looks at the display with existential horror.
en: Amaura looks at the display with existential horror.
ja: アマルスが、存在への恐怖を感じているような目で展示を見つめている。

key: A broken mirror, reflecting the impermanent past.
en: A broken mirror, reflecting the impermanent past.
ja: 割れた鏡が、移ろいゆく過去を映している。

key: Lavender Tower, a place that carries souls of Pokémon.
en: Lavender Tower, a place that carries souls of Pokémon.
ja: ラベンダータワー、ポケモンの魂を運ぶ場所。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Tyrantrum.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Tyrantrum.
ja: ガチゴラスに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: The inscription on display describes ancient holy symbols.
en: The inscription on display describes ancient holy symbols.
ja: 展示された碑文には、古代の聖なる象徴について記されている。

key: "Golden arcs cross in light... "
en: "Golden arcs cross in light... "
ja: 「光の中で交わる、黄金の弧……」

key: "...The body of the creator becomes our communion..."
en: "...The body of the creator becomes our communion..."
ja: 「……創造主の身体が、我らの交わりとなる……」

key: "The tilted cross pattern..."
en: "The tilted cross pattern..."
ja: 「傾いた十字の紋様……」

key: "...Four points for four values core to spirit..."
en: "...Four points for four values core to spirit..."
ja: 「……精神の核となる四つの価値のための、四つの点……」

key: A replica of ancient Ruby crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
en: A replica of ancient Ruby crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
ja: 古代の宗教実践者にとって重要だったと考えられる、古代のルビー結晶のレプリカ。

key: A replica of ancient Sapphire crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
en: A replica of ancient Sapphire crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
ja: 古代の宗教実践者にとって重要だったと考えられる、古代のサファイア結晶のレプリカ。

key: A replica of ancient Emerald crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
en: A replica of ancient Emerald crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
ja: 古代の宗教実践者にとって重要だったと考えられる、古代のエメラルド結晶のレプリカ。

key: A replica of ancient Amethyst crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
en: A replica of ancient Amethyst crystal, thought to be important to ancient religious practicioners.
ja: 古代の宗教実践者にとって重要だったと考えられる、古代のアメジスト結晶のレプリカ。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Aurorus.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Aurorus.
ja: アマルルガに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Armaldo.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Armaldo.
ja: アーマルドに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Cradily.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Cradily.
ja: ユレイドルに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Omanyte.
en: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Omanyte.
ja: オムナイトに近縁と考えられる、小型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Kabuto.
en: The fossil of a small Pokémon, thought to be related to Kabuto.
ja: カブトに近縁と考えられる、小型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Bastiodon.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Bastiodon.
ja: トリデプスに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Relicanth.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Relicanth.
ja: ジーランスに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: Centuries of history and life-- reduced to mere bone.
en: Centuries of history and life-- reduced to mere bone.
ja: 何世紀もの歴史と生命が――ただの骨に成り果てた。

key: What sort of lives did these old structures once lead?
en: What sort of lives did these old structures once lead?
ja: これらの古い骨格は、かつてどんな生を送っていたのだろう?

key: What sort of memories must they have had?
en: What sort of memories must they have had?
ja: どんな記憶を持っていたのだろう?

key: And what experiences have been cursed by the sands of time to fall away to dust?
en: And what experiences have been cursed by the sands of time to fall away to dust?
ja: そして、どんな経験が、時の砂に呪われてちりとなって消えていったのだろう?

key: All that experience now is meaningless.
en: All that experience now is meaningless.
ja: その経験すべてが、今は無意味なものになっている。

key: I wonder if it ever had meaning?
en: I wonder if it ever had meaning?
ja: そもそも、意味などあったのだろうか?

key: It is a poor substitute to find out,
en: It is a poor substitute to find out,
ja: それを知るには、お粗末な代用品だけれど、

key: But perhaps next time someone asks you for a password, you can tell them "0exp".
en: But perhaps next time someone asks you for a password, you can tell them "0exp".
ja: 今度誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら、「0exp」とでも答えてみるといい。

key: Then you can see what it is like to have all the experience you would have earned fall away from you at once.
en: Then you can see what it is like to have all the experience you would have earned fall away from you at once.
ja: 得られたはずの経験が、すべて一瞬で消え去るというのがどういうことか、身をもって知れるだろう。

key: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Carracosta.
en: The fossil of a large Pokémon, thought to be related to Carracosta.
ja: アバゴーラに近縁と考えられる、大型ポケモンの化石。

key: Burned Tower, a monument to history and tradition.
en: Burned Tower, a monument to history and tradition.
ja: やけたやぐら、歴史と伝統の記念碑。

key: Fortree City, where people live in harmony with nature.
en: Fortree City, where people live in harmony with nature.
ja: ヤシガタウン、自然と調和して人々が暮らす街。

key: Spear Pillar, the bridge between our world and the last.
en: Spear Pillar, the bridge between our world and the last.
ja: シンオウ神殿、我々の世界と過去の世界をつなぐ橋。

key: A scene in springtime Unova. Cherry blossoms flutter through the air.
en: A scene in springtime Unova. Cherry blossoms flutter through the air.
ja: イッシュ地方の春の光景。桜の花びらが宙に舞う。

key: A scene in midsummer Unova. The air shimmers with heat on the canvas.
en: A scene in midsummer Unova. The air shimmers with heat on the canvas.
ja: イッシュ地方の真夏の光景。キャンバスの上で、空気が陽炎のように揺らめく。

key: A scene in autumnal Unova. Leaves glisten in every shade of the rainbow.
en: A scene in autumnal Unova. Leaves glisten in every shade of the rainbow.
ja: イッシュ地方の秋の光景。木の葉が、虹のあらゆる色に輝く。

key: A scene in a Unovan winter. Snow crests every surface, illuminating the world.
en: A scene in a Unovan winter. Snow crests every surface, illuminating the world.
ja: イッシュ地方の冬の光景。あらゆる場所に雪が積もり、世界を照らしている。

key: A faraway dial used to track the passage of time.
en: A faraway dial used to track the passage of time.
ja: 遠い地の、時の流れを追うための文字盤。

key: The altar of the sun and moon, central to Alolan legend.
en: The altar of the sun and moon, central to Alolan legend.
ja: アローラ伝説の中心にある、太陽と月の祭壇。

key: A faraway hotel bustling with tourists above a vibrant coastal city.
en: A faraway hotel bustling with tourists above a vibrant coastal city.
ja: 活気ある沿岸都市を見下ろす、観光客でにぎわう遠い地のホテル。

key: Looking at this place rejuvenates your soul.
en: Looking at this place rejuvenates your soul.
ja: この場所を見ていると、魂が若返るようだ。

key: A city glows crimson, its vibrant hues a testament to the liveliness of its people.
en: A city glows crimson, its vibrant hues a testament to the liveliness of its people.
ja: 街が深紅に輝き、その鮮やかな色彩が人々の活気を物語っている。

key: Despite its colorful nature, you're somehow still left feeling desolate.
en: Despite its colorful nature, you're somehow still left feeling desolate.
ja: 色彩豊かであるにもかかわらず、なぜか荒涼とした気持ちにさせられる。

key: Byxbysion Wasteland, rendered in all of its unending chaos.
en: Byxbysion Wasteland, rendered in all of its unending chaos.
ja: ビクスビシオン荒れ地、その終わりなきこんとんのすべてが描かれている。

key: Beryl Cemetery, where the souls of the departed are forever honored.
en: Beryl Cemetery, where the souls of the departed are forever honored.
ja: ベリル墓地、旅立った魂が永遠に敬われる場所。

key: Chrysolia Springs, a fusion of fire and water in unforgettable harmony.
en: Chrysolia Springs, a fusion of fire and water in unforgettable harmony.
ja: クリソリア温泉、忘れがたい調和の中で炎と水が融合する。

key: An artistic rendition of Arceus, thought to have been recovered from ancient religious practicioners.
en: An artistic rendition of Arceus, thought to have been recovered from ancient religious practicioners.
ja: 古代の宗教実践者から発見されたと考えられる、アルセウスの芸術的な描写。

key: A hidden tower in the desert, appearing only to those who step thrice through the oases, or four quarters more after that.
en: A hidden tower in the desert, appearing only to those who step thrice through the oases, or four quarters more after that.
ja: 砂漠に隠された塔。オアシスを三度通り抜けた者、あるいはさらにその後四分の四を経た者にのみ姿を現す。

key: A waterfall leading out from a vast mountain range. It pours over the city walls in a great rain.
en: A waterfall leading out from a vast mountain range. It pours over the city walls in a great rain.
ja: 広大な山脈から流れ出す滝。街の城壁を越え、大雨のように降り注ぐ。

key: Welcome to the Spinel Museum Giftshop, where the fun is so cool, it Nevermelts!
en: Welcome to the Spinel Museum Giftshop, where the fun is so cool, it Nevermelts!
ja: スピネル博物館ギフトショップへようこそ、ここの楽しさは、ネバーメルトのように溶けない冷たさです!

key: We sell select type battle items and Pokémon fossils for new and experienced Trainers.
en: We sell select type battle items and Pokémon fossils for new and experienced Trainers.
ja: 新人からベテランまで、選りすぐりのタイプ対応バトルアイテムとポケモン化石を販売しています。

key: Remember to revive your fossils upstairs!
en: Remember to revive your fossils upstairs!
ja: 化石は、上の階で復元するのをお忘れなく!

key: Please enjoy our new giftshop!
en: Please enjoy our new giftshop!
ja: 新しいギフトショップを、ぜひお楽しみください!

key: Since the whole city being renovated we thought we'd do a renovation of our own.
en: Since the whole city being renovated we thought we'd do a renovation of our own.
ja: 街全体が改装されているので、私たちも独自に改装してみることにしました。

key: I used to bring my Amaura here, before I realized a place full of skeletons like this probably scared her.
en: I used to bring my Amaura here, before I realized a place full of skeletons like this probably scared her.
ja: 前はアマルスをここに連れてきていたんですが、骨格標本だらけのこういう場所は、たぶん彼女を怖がらせていたんだと気づいて。

key: Now she stays home when I visit this place.
en: Now she stays home when I visit this place.
ja: 今は、ここに来る時、あの子は家で待たせてるんです。

key: I caught another Pokémon friend for her, too!
en: I caught another Pokémon friend for her, too!
ja: それに、あの子のために、もう一匹ポケモンの友達も捕まえたんですよ!

key: A Duskull I call Grim.
en: A Duskull I call Grim.
ja: グリムって呼んでる、ヨマワルです。

key: I'm sure that'll make her feel better!
en: I'm sure that'll make her feel better!
ja: きっと、あの子も元気になるはずです!

key: It's written in an ancient language.
en: It's written in an ancient language.
ja: 古代の言語で書かれている。

key: It is believed to translate to:
en: It is believed to translate to:
ja: 次のように訳されると考えられている:

key: "The serpent of eternity holds all of the planets of the universe on its hoods.
en: "The serpent of eternity holds all of the planets of the universe on its hoods.
ja: 「永遠の蛇は、そのフードの上に宇宙のすべての惑星を抱く。

key: When it uncoils, time moves forward and creation takes place.
en: When it uncoils, time moves forward and creation takes place.
ja: それがとぐろを解く時、時は進み、創造が起こる。

key: When it coils back, the universe ceases to exist."
en: When it coils back, the universe ceases to exist."
ja: それがとぐろを巻き戻す時、宇宙は存在をやめる」

key: A depiction of Trillium aeternus set in stone.
en: A depiction of Trillium aeternus set in stone.
ja: 石に刻まれた「トリリウム・エテルヌス」の描写。

key: Prominently used in the symbology of an ancient civilization, it is unknown what meaning this flower held.
en: Prominently used in the symbology of an ancient civilization, it is unknown what meaning this flower held.
ja: 古代文明の象徴として顕著に用いられていたが、この花が持つ意味は不明である。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Plume
en: Plume
ja: はねのカセキ

key: Cover

ja: ふたのカセキ
